labels.statement: (10,8) A-vanish (7,1) is PROVEN impossible: no cover realizes the class. L7 (PR 2933, PROVEN; a general pigeonhole valid at m=6) forces |A0+A1| = 25 with |A0| = |A1| = 5 in F2^5 (all 25 cross sums distinct); with f = 1_A0, g = 1_A1, h = 1_S on S = A0+A1, Fourier over F2^5 gives h_hat = f_hat g_hat pointwise, so Parseval forces sum_{v!=0} h_hat^2 = 32*25 - 625 = 175 while odd parity (both sizes odd) makes f_hat^2, g_hat^2 >= 1 pointwise and (f_hat^2-1)(g_hat^2-1) >= 0 forces sum_{v!=0} f_hat^2 g_hat^2 >= 135 + 135 - 31 = 239 > 175. Contradiction.
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: Exact integers in tight.fourier_71_identity (verify.py quick prints FOURIER (7,1) need=175 lower=239 contradiction=True). The identity is tight exactly where covers exist: the m=4 analogue (|A0| = 7, |A1| = 1 in F2^3) computes need = lower = 7 and its class has 512 real covers (both reproduced in the m=4 control).

labels.statement: Independently, (10,8) A-vanish (7,1) is empty by complete enumeration: zero normalized Sidon 5-pairs (0 in both sets, Delta(A0) disjoint from Delta(A1), equivalent to |A0+A1| = 25) exist in F2^5. Coverage in the class is independent of the free parameter d1 (every H'-valued coverage line translates by d1 as a whole), so no configuration is hidden in the parameter.
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: tight.class71_pairs (complete backtracking over all C(31,4) normalized A1 and all admissible A0) returns 0 pairs; the algorithm is validated against full brute force at m=4 (5040 = 5040, test_sidon_backtracking_m4_matches_bruteforce), against plain inner loops on 12 m=5 slices (0 mismatches), and 2M random F2^5 pairs top out at |A0+A1| = 23. The d1 invariance is proven in the module docstring and machine-checked (test_class71_free_parameter_invariance). Receipt: TIGHT-PROGRESS.json class71 (PASS_TIGHT_CLASS71).

labels.statement: (10,8) D-vanish (8,2) is PROVEN impossible: all 28,815,360 L7-forced equality configurations fail all three translated coverage lines simultaneously (fail_hist = {('I','II','III'): 28815360}), zero covers. The parametrization: 4,287,920 normalized Sidon 4-pairs (D0, D1) with 0 in both (|D0+D1| = 16); of these 112,560 have the complement C of D0+D1 1-invariant (necessary for |A0+A1| = 16), each contributing up to 2^8 = 256 A0t = A0 + w choice sets; coverage is independent of the free parameter w (proven; the whole configuration's H'-valued lines translate by w).
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: tight.class82_run, complete 8-shard walk with per-shard receipts (TIGHT-PROGRESS.json class82; PASS_TIGHT_CLASSES). Normalization (0 in D0, 0 in D1, delta = 1 under GL(5,2)) is complete: half-translations and a common GL(5,2) map preserve all four L3 lines (machine-checked, test_half_translation_invariance). End-to-end reduction validation at m=4: the four L3 lines and a DIRECT S+S = F2^5 cover test agree on all 4,096 analogue configurations with 512 covers accepted by both routes (test_m4_class71_analogue_direct_agreement).

labels.statement: (12,6) A-vanish (6,0) is PROVEN impossible: no 6-set D of F2^5 admits any 6-set X with X + D = F2^5. All 169,911 normalized 6-sets D (0 in D) were walked with a complete branch-on-uncovered transversal search: every D has zero 6-set transversals, so lines (I'')/(II'') of the class are unsatisfiable.
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: tight.transversals6 + tight.class60_run, complete 8-shard walk over all C(31,5) = 169,911 normalized D with per-shard receipts (TIGHT-C60-*.json, merged by run_tight.py merge60; PASS_TIGHT_CLASSES shows d_checked=169911, d_with_transversals=0). Normalization (0 in D via the H-half translation, 0 in A1 via the H'-half translation; the class forces D1 empty) is complete. Positive control: the same search logic recovers real transversals at m=3 for 4+2 full pairs (test_transversals6_positive_control_m3).

labels.statement: Multiplicity classification (the forced excess-4 structure of any full-sumset 6-set pair in F2^5): r = 1 + rho with sum rho = 4; per nonzero v, f_hat(v) g_hat(v) = rho_hat(v) in {0, +-4}; |V22| = 2 sum rho^2 - 1. Exactly two patterns survive: rho = 2+2 on two points (|V22| = 15) and rho = 1+1+1+1 on an affine 2-flat {p1, p2, p3, p1+p2+p3} (|V22| = 7). The patterns 4*delta_p (Parseval forces 156 = 124 + (36a+16b) with |Vf| = 0), 3+1 (rho_hat attains +-2 for p != q) and 2+1+1 (|V22| = 2^{5-r}-1 in {1,3,7,15,31}, never 11) are PROVEN dead.
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: tight.rho_classification (exact integers) with the Walsh constraints machine-checked on random and explicit instances (test_walsh_constraints: 2+1+1 sizes sampled over 300 instances lie in {1,3,7,15,31}; the 3+1 +-2 witness; explicit 2+2 gives 15; explicit 2-flat gives 7).

labels.statement: (11,7)/(9,9) identity gap: the cross-sum multiplicity identity yields PROVEN necessary conditions - for an odd-odd split (s, t) covering A + D = E = F2^6, sum rho^2 >= 17 at (11,7) (excess 13) and >= 19 at (9,9) (excess 17) - excluding the all-ones excess pattern on both splits and the single-double pattern (2, 1^11) at (11,7).
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: tight.identity_odd_sides: pointwise (f_hat^2-1)(g_hat^2-1) >= 0 (both Walsh transforms odd since s, t odd) summed over 63 nonzero characters against Parseval (64*sum rho^2 - excess^2 >= (64s-s^2)+(64t-t^2)-63); exact integers asserted in test_identity_odd_sides_numbers and positively validated on every odd-odd-split cover of F2^4 (test_identity_soundness_on_f24_covers).

labels.statement: The same identity is DEMOTED as an exclusion mechanism for (11,7)/(9,9): the bounds sum rho^2 >= 17 resp. >= 19 are attainable by integer multiplicity patterns, so no contradiction arises (the excess 13/17 is too large for the rigidity that killed (7,1)). The row remainders 501/196 stand.
labels.label: DEMOTED
labels.evidence: tight.identity_odd_sides reports contradiction=False for both splits with sum_rho2_max = 169 resp. 289 (verify.py classes prints both lines); allowed patterns include (2,2,1^9) [17] and (3,1^10) [19] at (11,7) and (2,1^15) [19] at (9,9).

result: KB3g tight-class resolution (outcome=partial): the 18-point cover question for F2^7 is not decided, but its three tightest classes are. The (10,8) tight classes A-vanish (7,1) and D-vanish (8,2) and the (12,6) full-sumset class A-vanish (6,0) are each PROVEN impossible - (7,1) by an exact Fourier/Parseval contradiction (175 < 239) plus a zero Sidon-5-pair enumeration, (8,2) by complete enumeration of all 28,815,360 L7-forced equality configurations (every one fails all three coverage lines), (6,0) by a complete transversal walk over all 169,911 normalized 6-sets D (no 6-set X has X + D = F2^5), with an exact multiplicity classification of the forced excess-4 structure alongside. The (11,7)/(9,9) identity gap is pressed with the cross-sum multiplicity identity: PROVEN necessary conditions sum rho^2 >= 17 resp. >= 19 (excluding the all-ones excess pattern and more), but no contradiction - DEMOTED as an exclusion mechanism, row remainders 501/196 stand. No kappa, supplier or selected-frontier change; the gap 20 <= f(7) <= 24 is unchanged.
